content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the Chennai Port Authority Pilot (Class-I) Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 11-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of Chennai Port Authority to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Chennai Port Authority Pilot (Class-I) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Chennai Port Authority Pilot (Class-I) recruitment is 11 September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Pilot (Class-I) post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies for the Pilot (Class-I) post in the Chennai Port Authority recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What are the essential qualifications for the Pilot (Class-I) position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Certificate of Competency as Master of a Foreign Going Ship and have one year of post-qualification experience as Master or Chief Officer of a foreign going ship.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to the Pilot (Class-I) post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Pilot (Class-I) post is 40 years. Age relaxations are applicable for SC/ST, OBC, and existing employees.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: As per the information available, there is no application fee mentioned for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Pilot (Class-I) post?
faq.answer: The revised salary for the Pilot (Class-I) post ranges from Rs. 70,000 to Rs. 2,00,000 per month.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for the Chennai Port Authority Pilot (Class-I) recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official application portal of the Ministry of Shipping. The link is provided in the Important Links section.

faq.question: Q8. Are there any age relaxations for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxations are provided for SC/ST candidates (05 years) and OBC candidates (03 years). Existing employees have a maximum age limit of 55 years.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required during the application process?
faq.answer: Candidates need to submit self-attested copies of certificates for Age/Date of Birth, Educational Qualification, Experience (CoC, CDC), and Caste Certificates, along with a passport-size photo.
